caption: The drawing depicts a set of traditional clothing consisting of pants and a short jacket, shown from both front and back views. The pants are teal with a high waist, featuring a dark black wavy stripe running vertically down the front of each leg and a decorative pattern along the side seams. The waistband and fly area have a checkered pattern in black and white, while the buttons on the left side are red with white detailing. The jacket, matching the teal color of the pants, has black accents on the lapels, cuffs, and pocket flaps as well as a similar checkered lining visible at the collar and front opening. The jacket is adorned with symmetrical, ornate embroidered designs in light gray or white on the front lower panels, cuffs, and the back, and features two small pockets on the front. The visual arrangement places the pants on the left side of the image, while the jacket is displayed on the right, with one view showing the front and another, smaller view, showing the back. The background is plain and off-white.
title: Jacket
